cues.name: CastingChime
cues.prompt: One delicate brass and glass chime as a forensic label settles onto furniture. Brief warm attack, clear tiny decay, no music or voice.

cues.name: ToastTick
cues.prompt: One very soft dry wooden tick for a peripheral notification. Tiny precise click, no ringing, no music.

cues.name: PullMemory
cues.prompt: A paper photograph pulled out of an airy glowing memory: soft papery sliding whoosh, delicate shimmering tail, no impact or voice.

cues.name: LiftInspect
cues.prompt: A small ceramic object gently lifted off a wooden surface, subtle fingertip scrape and short airy rise, no speech or music.
